title: FNVR - Fictions Narratives en Vers de la Renaissance (1490-1600)
notes: FNVR is a Litt&Arts (Grenoble) project building XML-TEI editions of French verse narratives composed or translated 1490-1600, some first modern editions, led by Pascale Mounier; the TEI dataset is openly published on Recherche Data Gouv (DOI 10.57745/SSC5XT). The collected texts (amantDesconforte, chevallier, palamon, rondeaux) match the repository layout on the Grenoble GitLab, whose project page is live (200). Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: ELAN / UMR Litt&Arts (CNRS / Universite Grenoble Alpes), dir. Pascale Mounier
